Company History
December 1946         Company founded by Riichi Matsubara
October 1968              Incorporated as Shoei Specialty Printing Co., Ltd.
Haruo Matsubara is appointed as Representative Director and President
Company relocates to new plant constructed in Ichibacho, Akechicho, Ena City
February 1985            Participated in the construction of a new printing plant in Shanghai, China, and provided technology
May 1997                    Technical cooperation with Malaysian company Venture Bridge
April 2007                   ISO 9001 certification acquired
June 2008                   ISO 14001 certification acquired
September 2010        Koji Matsubara is appointed as Representative Director and President
December 2015         Shoei Specialty Printing celebrates its 70th anniversary
May 2022                    Company relocates to new plant constructed in Araicho, Akechicho, Ena City
